label: A10B_cF44_225_cf_a-001
title: LaH$_{10}$ High-T$_{c}$ Superconductor Structure
comments:
This structure was predicted by (Liu, 2017) as a possible near-room-temperature superconductor at pressures above 200 GPa.  Its existence was confirmed by (Geballe, 2018). 
 The lattice constant $a = 4.78${\AA} is taken from the (Liu, 2017) prediction at 300 GPa. (Geballe, 2018) found $a = 5.09${\AA} at 172 GPa, however that measurement does not appear in the ICSD, only in Table S2 of their supplementary information. 
 (Liu, 2017) 
 ICSD entries 259264 through 259303 are associated with (Geballe, 2018), but none of them include hydrogen positions and all have much smaller lattice constants than those given for LaH$_{10}$, leading us to believe that they represent calibration runs using elemental materials. 
 The AFLOW prototype label convention moves the origin by (a/2 a/2 a/2) from the published version, moving the lanthanum site from (4b) to (4a).
